title: Beef and cabbage keema with potatoes

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is plain fresh food or ordinary cupboard staples such as curry powder, tinned tomatoes and stock.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including the cavolo nero, is an everyday item at Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded casserole and a wooden spoon, and the technique is simple frying and simmering.

works.reason: 500g mince, 400g potatoes and half a cabbage make a sensible amount for four, and the liquid, seasoning and simmer times should give a tender, well-flavoured keema.

honest_times.reason: About 12 minutes of chopping plus 14 minutes of browning fits the 25 minutes of prep, and 15 plus 12 plus 3 minutes of simmering matches the 30 minutes of cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, nothing unlisted appears, and every name matches its id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Half a white cabbage is central to a warming March curry and is named in the title.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English with useful cues such as browned, fragrant and tender.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling family dinner of mince, potatoes and plenty of greens.
